reason: Adds a DeepSeek Harness settings page for browsing, searching, annotating, backing up, restoring, unarchiving, and permanently deleting archived chat sessions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供已归档聊天设置页，用于按工作区浏览、搜索、标注、备份、恢复、取消归档和删除会话。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness settings page to browse, search, annotate, back up, restore, unarchive, and delete archived chat sessions.

capabilities: Browse and search locally archived chat sessions
Filter and sort archived sessions by metadata
Edit local tags and notes for archived sessions
Export archived sessions as ZIP backups containing JSON and Markdown
Import and restore sessions from compatible ZIP backups
Unarchive sessions and permanently delete local session data
